title: Simplify GUI (Dark)
description: Simplify revamps Minecraft’s old boring GUI, and makes it looks smoother and cleaner!
body:
# **Simplify GUI (Dark)**

| changes all containers, Player's Hotbar & XP bar and more...

- Simplify GUI is still a work in progress and you may see some things missing!

# **Mod Support**

- [uku's Armor HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukus-armor-hud)
- [Skin Shuffle](https://modrinth.com/mod/skinshuffle)
